messages.subject: default font family and changing to Arial
parts:
Hi,

I´ve got two questions concerning fonts:

1) What excactly is the default font family "sans", some kind of Helvetica?

2) I want to change the font family of my qplot with the package "extrafont" to Arial and save it as a pdf. It turns out, that some font types are working and some aren´t (e.g. Arial and Corbel). What I am seeing in the PDF are that the axis label letters are on top of each other and thus unreadable. 

The fonts from windows are already loaded, which I can see with fonts(), and the Ghostscript should be activated through
Sys.setenv(R_GSCMD="C:/Program Files/gs/gs9.14/bin/gswin64c.exe")

Here is the code for plotting (Newest R version and Package versions)

S <- qplot(x,y, data=all)  +
facet_wrap(~age) +
theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, family="Arial"))

ggsave("test.pdf",S)
embed_fonts("test.pdf",outfile="test_embed.pdf")

Thanks for help
